alternative_explanations: The learned energy may simply reconstruct a classical parity-check graph; exact minimum-distance decoding or Sipser-Spielman-style bit flipping may explain all recovery more cheaply.
confounds: The 63-bit simplex family has large distance, six latent degrees of freedom and basis-spanning training even at K=8; K adds examples from one family rather than independent open-world facts. Hidden column permutation and affine polarity remove stable message IDs but do not make the task representative of language. All candidates receive the same corrupted raw bits and D budget; factor discovery, full span construction, scans, rounds, state, update and workload are charged.
falsification_criteria: Make HYP-0007 dormant if learned parallel energy is below 0.95 accuracy in any cell, produces spurious non-codewords, differs materially from oracle factor behavior because factor learning fails, or is dominated in capability and full cost by exact affine decoding or sequential classical factor descent.

outcome_policy.negative: Failure on held-out codewords, deeper corruption or ambiguity would reject this implementation and make HYP-0007 dormant without tuning.
outcome_policy.null: Matched recovery with dominance by exact affine decoding or equivalence to classical bit flipping would show that energy is only an alternative description of known error correction and make HYP-0007 dormant.
outcome_policy.positive: Only a non-dominated learned parallel result distinct from exact and bit-flip controls would justify a broader overlapping-factor screen; no claim about LLM replacement is permitted.

predicted_outcome: Training examples span one hidden six-bit affine family but expose no message or task ID. Stored nearest and Hopfield should fail on held-out codewords. Exact affine decoding, learned parallel energy, sequential factor descent and oracle factors should recover most or all cells; learned parallel must use one update round, but exact decoding is predicted to match capability with lower state or full workload, making the likely outcome a classical-decoding null rather than an energy advantage.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote. Advance only if learned parallel has at least 0.95 cold/warm/near accuracy in every cell, zero spurious rate, one monotonic round, a distinct non-dominated full-system signature versus exact affine and sequential controls, positive reusable structure learning, local update retention, integrity PASS, and a plausible distinction from SRC-0081 through SRC-0083.
research_question: Can a learned third-order energy over densely overlapping hidden constraints recover held-out affine codewords from D=1/4/6 corruptions in one parallel relaxation while beating exact learned affine-span decoding, sequential factor descent, Hopfield retrieval and stored nearest neighbours after full fit/state/update/workload accounting?
title: Overlapping-factor energy transfer without task IDs
